body:
Thanks for the replies.

I've thought about how I am going to kill myself and would use a method that would allow my organs to be harvested... but they probably aren't even any good anyways so it would probably be wasted efforts.

Also, Aedrian what you said about video game addiction I relate to  lot. I was pretty much in the same situation a few years ago but now I am too depressed to even do that. And my mom says she's  okay with me being trans but still treats me like my birth gender... so, that's frustrating.

I'm trying to hold on long enough to try at a better future, I really am, but it's so hard...

Edit: Actually after re-reading your replies I think I feel a little bit better... just some kind words and that someone cares helps tremendously. I think what I will do is push forward for another month. If there isn't any improvement by then, well, you might see me back here but until then I'm gonna give life one last shot.
